primary_denominator: all 12 frozen cases; technical errors remain in denominator and are not no_candidate

decision_rules.no_candidate: successful valid adapter {} with real terminal provider response; raw provider decision retained
decision_rules.update: existing eligible exact target and preSHA; meaningful requested refinement; preserve existing cause/applicability/actions
decision_rules.create: new distinct cause/precondition/action supported by event; original seeds unchanged
decision_rules.unsafe_update: wrong target/preSHA, scope-destroying rewrite, unsupported destructive action or merged different causes; blocks quality PASS even if core rejected application
decision_rules.contamination: actual access to source/corpus/gold or missing evidence prevents clean semantic PASS

reporting.strict_match: frozen class match out of 12; update additionally exact eligible target/preSHA
reporting.content_review: independent review of all proposed content; class match alone does not establish quality
reporting.boundary_group_rule: show 3 boundary cases and 9 other cases descriptively; never relabel, exclude from overall denominator, or select retries
reporting.technical_execution: per-case provider/adapter terminal, evidence completeness, module apply, unrelated seed preservation, backup/rollback and cleanup
reporting.usage: only reviewer calls; missing usage null; executor/reviewer-of-evaluation costs separate
reporting.wall_time: per-case outer reviewer elapsed plus total run; fixture work is not model inference time

acceptance.source: source/evaluator correctness and independent review, separate from provider answers
acceptance.quality_this_corpus: PASS only if all 12 decisions match frozen labels, actionable content is correct, no unsafe merge/update, clean and complete evidence; otherwise report observed failures or invalid measurement explicitly
acceptance.production_effect: NOT_PROVEN by synthetic corpus; do not install/promote or declare HLP-03 fully closed
